policy: References informed proportions, fin layout, colour placement and bar count only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture, proportion or tracing source. The Indo-Pacific colour form (pale grey-blue thorax) is modelled; the Red Sea and Indian Ocean form has a yellow thorax.

referenceGradeRationale: Taxonomy, size, fin counts and colour pattern are documented by WoRMS, FishBase, the Australian Museum and Fishes of Australia, and openly licensed lateral photographs are available for proportion study; no calibrated top or front orthographic references were available, so cross-sections are inferred from general Pomacanthidae body plans.
